Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Thames Valley Police recorded 114 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 7.8 per 1,000 residents, the 14th highest rate of Oxford's 24 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (4), vehicle crime (2), burglary (1); the evening/night score by violent crime (15), anti social behaviour (4), public order (3). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Wolvercote safe?

Wandroz currently rates Wolvercote in Oxford as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Oxford during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Oxford at night. This rating is derived from Thames Valley Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Wolvercote safe at night?

At night, Wolvercote is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Oxford. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Wolvercote a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Wolvercote's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Oxford) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
